Reality -> Representation -> Correction -> Adaptation -> New Representation; compressed as R->Omega->C->A->R'.
R is the model of reality containing extracted structure, compressed information, and predictive relationships; failure R not approximately Reality.
Omega is reachable future space; representation is valuable insofar as it changes reachable adaptive possibilities.
C is the mechanism through which consequences update the system; requirement E_t->C_(t+1).
A is improvement of the transformation process; F_(t+1)=G(F_t,E_t), not merely state transition.
Hierarchy X->F (state), X->F->G (learning), X->F->G->mathcal G (recursive adaptation).
Omega_t -> Delta mathcal G_(t+1): constraint information changes future adaptive mechanism space.

Maximize performance subject to preserved correction; feedback is treated as the mechanism preserving adaptation.

Preserve failure->information->correction so error remains informative.

Principle 10 — Optimize the Process, Not Just the Outcome
Optimize ability to discover better results rather than only current result.
Build systems that become more capable without becoming less teachable.
